Name: Change Farm Cave
Author: DyBlz3156
Description:
[size=3][color=#ffff00]At first, Demetrius asked if you wanted to choose [/color][color=#e06666][b]Mushroom[/b][/color][color=#ffff00] or [/color][color=#6d9eeb][b]Bat[/b][/color][color=#ffff00] for your [/color][color=#cccccc][b]Farm Cave[/b][/color][color=#ffff00] type. If you regret now, use this mod to modify your choice!
This mod is actually a editor script that does not require SMAPI support. It can be run directly to modify your game save.
[/color][color=#ffff00]当初，德米特里厄斯询问你想为[/color][color=#b6b6b6][b]农场洞穴[/b][/color][color=#ffff00]类型选择[/color][color=#e06666][b]蘑菇[/b][/color][color=#ffff00]或[/color][color=#6d9eeb][b]蝙蝠[/b][/color][color=#ffff00]。如果你现在后悔了，使用该模组来修改你的选择。[/color]
[color=#ffff00]该模组实际上是一个编辑器脚本，因此不需要 SMAPI 的支持也可以运行，它能够直接作用于你的存档。[/color][/size]

[color=#ff00ff][size=4][b]How to Use 使用说明[/b][/size][/color][color=#ff0000][size=3]
Please copy the program [b]ChangeFarmCave.exe [/b]into the save folder you want to modify. If your Farm Cave is already set to Mushroom or Bat, running the program will change it to the other type and back up your save. 
Note: The program only works on common Windows platforms (supports PowerShell 5.1). If your save is on an Android device or other operating systems, please transfer the save file to a Windows device for processing, and then transfer it back to the original device after the modification is complete.
请将程序 [b]ChangeFarmCave.exe [/b]复制到你要修改的存档文件夹内，如果你的农场洞穴已经选择了蘑菇或者蝙蝠，执行后会更改为另一种，并备份存档。
注意，程序仅能在常见的Windows平台操作(支持PowerShell 5.1)，如果你的存档位于Android手机或其他操作系统，请将存档文件发送到一个Windows设备上操作，处理完成后再转移回原设备即可。[/size][/color]

[b][color=#ff00ff][size=4]Compatibility 兼容性[/size][/color]
[/b][size=3][color=#ffff00]As long as the layout of the Farm Cave and the available options are not modified, it can be compatible!
只要不修改农场洞穴布局和选择，都可以兼容！[/color]
